briefing.headline: Deadline is Sat 21 Nov, 11:00 UTC; João Pedro, Gvardiol and other injury flags and big transfer swings are the main things to check before you lock in changes.

points.text: Gameweek 11 deadline is 21 November at 11:00 UTC.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: João Pedro (31.2% owned) has a thigh injury with an unknown return date. He was the most sold player.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Gvardiol, Virgil, Guéhi, Belloumi and Manzambi all have injury flags with a 75% chance of playing.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Most bought this week: N. Jackson, Evanilson, Barry, Van Hecke and Vuskovic. Most sold: João Pedro, Gvardiol, Guéhi, Calvert-Lewin and Thiago.
points.label: confirmed

points.text: Price rises are coming for Gabriel, Rice, Konsa, N. Jackson and Tavernier. Falls are for Saka, Madjo, Cook, Brooks and Schade.
